Deduction: headings are long noun stacks, e.g. L984 '독립 확장이 필요한 Python 파이프라인에 맞고 모델별 최적화 서버로는 부족한 선택지', L575 'serve build·serve deploy·serve status로 다루는 단일 진실 공급원 Serve 설정 파일'.
score_evidence.B: Mostly natural 입니다 register. Deductions: restatement crutches 'L21 결국 모델마다 자원과 레플리카 수를 따로 정해야 하는데' / 'L93 그래서 장애 복구는 결국 ...로 정리됩니다' / 'L138 결국 C++ CoreWorker가'; meta framing 'L157 아래는 그 액터들이 기대는 Ray 원 논문의 설계입니다' (rewrite: 'Serve 액터는 Ray 원 논문이 설계한 실행 기반 위에서 돕니다.'); calque '단일 진실 공급원' used three times (L577, L824); awkward heading L984 (rewrite: 'Ray Serve가 맞는 경우와 맞지 않는 경우').
score_evidence.C: Coherent arc problem -> units -> internals -> Ray base -> quickstart -> composition -> HTTP -> config -> KubeRay -> scaling -> observability -> choice. Deductions: L997 '(앞서 다룬 스케일링 기본 요소)' points to request batching, which the post never covers; L763 forward-anchors serveConfigV2 to 'KubeRay 이슈 #2557' instead of the docs; L990 says '표에서도 열을 나눴습니다' but the table at L992-995 splits rows, not columns, by source.
score_evidence.D: Good worked examples at hard points: power-of-two-choices table L124-132, backpressure arithmetic L841, cancellation propagation L567. Deduction: trivial arithmetic padded (L871 '$$1 / 0.25 = 4$$ ... $$4 \times 0.25 = 1$$장'); 30-line Ray-paper scheduler worked example L183 is long for its payoff.
score_evidence.E: 7 tables, ASCII diagrams, 30 code blocks placed where discussed. Deductions: no Serve architecture figure (official architecture-2.0.svg exists) - only ASCII L103-114; L990 table header claim mismatched with layout.
score_evidence.F: Claim sample 14/15 supported, 1 wrong: L659-682 presents a fabricated 'serve build가 막 출력한 파일' (app name 'default', 'num_replicas: 1' for both deployments). Running serve build on the post's own text_ml.py with Ray 2.60.0 yields 'name: app1', no num_replicas, plus logging_config and grpc 'enable_reflection: true'; the docs only show the hand-edited version. Outside the sample: L97 and L794 call the official Ray docs page architecture.md (docs.ray.io/en/latest/serve/architecture.html source) a '서드파티 문서'; Sources list omits cited discuss.ray.io answer (L800), Bhairav blog (L986, L995) and Serve LLM observability docs (L982), and lists an irrelevant 'take_batch' Ray Data page (L1026). L573 keep-alive '5초' matches docs prose but the 2.60 API default is 90 s (docs inconsistency, not penalized).
score_evidence.T1: Running example executes as pasted (ports substituted only): quickstart, composed app, FastAPI variant, text_ml.py via serve deploy, streaming handle and StreamingResponse all worked. Deductions: the shown serve build output does not match what readers will get (L661-682); sklearn example depends on an unshown training script (L282 acknowledges).
score_evidence.T2: Covers composition, handles, HTTP/FastAPI, config, KubeRay, backpressure, observability. Gaps: autoscaling_config (min/max replicas, target_ongoing_requests) never taught although the scaling section L818-881 is about load; @serve.batch request batching absent though the index page lists it as a core primitive; model multiplexing only named L1011. Padding: Ray 2018 paper section L155-185 (GCS chain replication, bottom-up scheduler) is weakly tied to Serve operation.
score_evidence.T3: Strong internals: controller/proxy/replica actors, p2c routing, autoscaler in controller with metric push, failure ownership table L148-153, cancellation semantics, KubeRay vs Serve recovery scope, PodMonitor rationale. Deductions: L183 applies the 2018 paper's local/global scheduler to placing a current Translator replica as if it were today's mechanism (modern Ray schedules actors via GCS), not named as that version's; official architecture doc mislabeled third-party (L97, L794).
